column2: $FIRST_ADJ$ War to End the False Caliphate
[Root.RelHead.GetBestName] suffers under the cruel overlordship of §Y$TARGET$§!. We should put an end to that.
§Y$TARGET$§! is not worthy of protecting [Root.RelHead.GetBestName]. We should take over this important duty!
§Y$TARGET$§! could really use a protector. Someone like [Root.GetBestName]...
§Y$TARGET$§!'s so-called caliphate is an insult to the Prophet and all true [Root.Religion.GetName] Muslims. We should put an end to it!
The one and only true caliph is [Root.GetBestName]. §Y$TARGET$§!'s false caliphate must be overthrown!
§Y$TARGET$§! follows a different [Root.Religion.GetName] school of Islamic jurisprudence. Their legal framework is thus quite flawed...
The area just around my capital really needs to be brought into line...
We should subjugate other rulers to prove ourselves the most exalted [Root.GetDevarajaDevarani] to walk this world.
We should subjugate other rulers to prove ourselves the most exalted [Root.GetDevarajaDevarani] to walk this world.
§Y$TARGET$§! rules a mighty mandala, but it is perhaps more fragile than it appears at a glance. We should shatter it and pick up the pieces!
§Y$TARGET$§! rules a mighty mandala, but it is perhaps more fragile than it appears at a glance. We should shatter it and pick up the pieces!
§Y$TARGET$§!'s capital is full of riches. They could be put to better use. My use!
We once ruled all of India, and we shall do so again!
All of India shall once again be part of our glorious mandala!
We once ruled all of India, and we shall do so again!
We once ruled all of Suvarnabhumi, and we shall do so again!
All of Suvarnabhumi shall once again be part of our glorious mandala!
$ORDER$$FIRST_ADJ$ War for a new Mayor in $OTHER_TITLE$
§Y$TARGET$§! should open the country and stop having it be closed.
§Y$CLAIMANT$§! can declare war to install a new mayor in the §Y$TITLE$§! since the current one has refused th most gracious offer to join §Y$CLAIMANT$§!'s trade league.
Foreign merchants under §Y$TARGET$§! bring dangerous ideas into our realm. They must be expelled.
§Y$TARGET$§!'s merchants have gained far too much influence in the realm. We must institute an embargo, and make all local cities leave §Y$TARGET$§!'s trade league.
§Y$TARGET$§! is embargoing our merchants. This cannot stand!
The §Y$TITLE$§! is part of my trade league, and the local mayor yearns for independence from §Y$TARGET$§!. Perhaps the time has come for decisive action...
The §Y$TITLE$§! is part of a rival trade league. §Y$TARGET$§! should be made to reconsider this unwise decision.
